messages:
Anna: quick PRD intake - proposing a feature 'Response Fidelity Budget'. Problem: customers want predictable token-cost reductions per-tenant without visible drops in perceived quality. Need: clear success metrics, rollout acceptance, and edge-case handling. Owners for evals/console/runtime required.

Jordan: is this driven by a single customer or broad demand? what's the target savings range?

Anna: primary ask from NimbusAI (enterprise). Target ~25-35% token cost reduction on non-critical paths. Important constraints: keep data residency, preserve audit trails, and allow per-tenant opt-in. They want a 5-tenant canary.

Mike: infra constraint - any routing/model-variant choices must keep hosted p95 latency <=250ms. Also, avoid frequent fallbacks—those can spike cost.

Sophie: UX idea - per-tenant control with three states: Off / Budgeted / Conservative. Budgeted shows estimated monthly savings and a link to a live quality chart. Conservative yields stricter probes and smaller savings. Simple inline help text and a small badge.

Raj: evaluation approach:
- offline: compute fidelity against baseline using top-k overlap and semantic similarity (embedding cosine).
- online probes: sample small % of live requests and do lightweight reruns to estimate divergence.
Proposed metrics: top3_match_delta_pct, median_embedding_drop, synthetic-LLM-consistency-score.

Kevin: runtime plan - implement 'budget router' flags to select quantized variants or token truncation strategies with per-tenant policy.
Fallback rules proposal:
- if top3_match_delta_pct > 5% on probes -> switch tenant to full model instantly
- if p95 latency > 250ms -> trigger autoscale or fallback
I'll spin up a feature branch for routing flags; Dedicated deployments will need a pinning option.

Anna: explicitly listing non-goals: not a wholesale model compression program, not changing weights, not exposing raw prompt logs, and not replacing contract SLAs.

Jordan: suggested acceptance criteria to include in PRD:
1) Budgeted tenants achieve >=20% measured token cost reduction in a two-week pilot
2) top3_match_delta_pct <=5% for >=95% of probes
3) p95 latency regression <=10% vs baseline
4) Console exposes opt-in toggle + savings estimate + link to quality graph
5) Rollback runbook and audit logs present and tested

Sophie: edge cases to call out: streaming responses (partial tokens matter), function-calling-heavy requests, tenants with heavy burst traffic. Default Conservative mode for streaming/function-calls?

Raj: eval harness details: need tenant-ground-truth datasets (customer-provided) + synthetic coverage. Sampling: min(1% of requests, 100/day). Also plan for backfilled baseline metrics using recent history.

Mike: infra blockers: Dedicated autoscaler must understand extra variant pools; update capacity calculator and quota checks for hosted. Ops: @DeployBot please schedule a capacity review.

DeployBot: @Mike capacity-review scheduled for 2024-08-06 16:00 UTC. Meeting invite sent.

Anna: owners & timeline:
- PRD draft owner: Anna
- Eval harness + metrics: Raj
- Runtime prototype + routing flags: Kevin + Mike
- Console + UX: Sophie
Milestones: PRD draft by EOD Friday, pilot plan and canary checklist due next Wednesday. @Jordan please review acceptance criteria after PRD.

Jordan: will review. please include exact observability queries and rollback SLO in the PRD so SRE can onboard quickly.

Anna: noted, will include runbook, rollback playbook, dashboard queries, and canary checklist. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
